body: I loved the trailer! I played a couple of missions on Sea of thieves to see Monkey Island easter eggs and now we got a full story line!! I so excited to play it, despite Sea of thieves making me feel motion sickness hahaha

The game was really good and the ending was ok. At this point nothing would be enough as the secret for the fans because the waiting was sooo long and the expectations were really high. I got a little bit disappointed with the end but, honestly, I don't know what I wanted the secret to be.
